$comment: GREP_SUMMARY: placement, placement.yaml, schema, context, vpn_enforced, nodes, modules, node, all-nodes, off, nodes-list, multi-node | STRUCTURE: ▶ placement.yaml → ┌context + vpn_enforced + nodes[] + modules{}┐ → ◇ Draft7Validator → ⎋ | MODULE_CONTRACT: @purpose Schema of node-configs/<context>/placement.yaml — module placement across nodes of one context (DevPlan 010 T0.1); @scope Multi-node topology declaration — context, vpn_enforced attestation, nodes (private hosts), modules placement forms; @invariants context pattern kebab-case, nodes minItems 1, modules forms are strict oneOf {node}/{mode:all-nodes}/{mode:off}/{nodes[]} each with additionalProperties false, top-level additionalProperties false, r2-removed reserved forms and public-host field absent from this schema (0 consumers); @rationale Single placement file is the only topology source; vpn_enforced/host privacy semantics live in the loader (T0.1: semantics in loader, not regex)
title: PlacementDeclaration
description: Schema for node-configs/<context>/placement.yaml — declares where each platform module runs within one deployment context (multi-node module placement, DevPlan 010). Absence of the file = single-node legacy resolve (no-op)

context.description: Context name — must equal contexts[0].name of every node in this placement (drift gate, DevPlan 010 §2.2 п.3)

vpn_enforced.description: Operator attestation: cross-node traffic flows over an encrypted channel (RFC1918 ≠ crypto). Mandatory true in multi-node — enforced by the loader (DevPlan 010 invariant 7), not by the schema

name.description: Node name — must have node-configs/<name>/node.yaml (reverse gate)

host.description: Private/VPN address for cross-node traffic (RFC1918 10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16 or CGNAT 100.64/10) — enforced by the loader via ipaddress, not regex (T0.1)

nodes.description: Members of the context (>=1); host is the address for cross-node traffic

oneOf.title: singleton
oneOf.description: Exactly one instance in the context, on the specified node

oneOf.title: all-nodes
oneOf.description: One instance on EVERY node of the context (collectors, node metrics)

oneOf.title: off
oneOf.description: Module is not deployed on any node of the context (explicit disable; completeness still requires the record)

oneOf.title: nodes-list
oneOf.description: One instance on EACH listed node; v1 — nginx only (multi-ingress, S2b)

modules.description: Module placement: key = module name from core/modules/<name>/, value = strict placement form (oneOf node / mode:all-nodes / mode:off / nodes[]). Reserved forms and the public-host field were REMOVED in revision 2 — they are not part of this schema (0 consumers, DevPlan 010 §2.1)
